name: backchain
description: Use when an implementation task needs a dependency-aware plan before coding: backward planner / backchain / precondition-first planning, dependency DAGs, elaborating incomplete plans, or scheduler-ready step graphs. Turns a natural-language coding request into a forward draft then backward-chaining enriched DAG with explicit unresolved risks, then directly calls the selected Until Loop to repeat dependency review until two consecutive trivial/no-change reviews.
